runtime_dependencies.name: Node.js
runtime_dependencies.purpose: Runs the JavaScript code for the server and API logic.

runtime_dependencies.name: Express
runtime_dependencies.purpose: Provides the routing and HTTP request handling for the REST API.

environment_variables.name: PORT
environment_variables.purpose: Specifies the port on which the server will listen for incoming requests.

container_recommendation.notes: Use the Node.js Alpine image for a small footprint; a single stage is sufficient due to the simple project structure.

filesystem_requirements.notes: Application source code and runtime must be able to read and potentially write within the container root.

assumption_flags: No persistent storage is required as the application uses in-memory data storage.
No authentication or authorization mechanisms are implemented or needed.
env_report.summary: The environment is a Docker container running Node.js with Express for a simple REST API. The biggest setup risk is managing memory usage due to in-memory notes storage, and ensuring proper communication of data loss risk.
